text: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.efo_term = 'prostate cancer'
